name: Ember 1
short: Fireworks Research's Kimi K3 fine-tune (1.04M context) for agentic coding; about 40% fewer tokens, SWE-bench 92.2% and DeepSWE 75.2%.
standout: The efficiency fine-tune: a Kimi K3 derivative that reaches comparable agentic-coding scores while emitting far fewer tokens — quality per billed token is the point.
tradeoff: It inherits K3’s shape but not Moonshot’s roadmap, and its tuning is narrower: outside agentic coding the base model is the safer bet.
